title: loanDepot Announces First Quarter 2026 Financial Results
summary: Company delivers market share gains and operational progress amid a challenging market. First Quarter 2026 Highlights: Loan origination volume decreased 5% to $7.66 billion from the prior quarter, while market share increased to 1.39%1. Revenue decreased 8% to $286 million and adjusted revenue decreased 5% to $299 million compared to the prior quarter, primarily impacted by volatile interest rates and margin pressure. Pull-through weighted gain on sale margin decreased 53 basis points to 271 basis points on larger loan balances, product mix shifts and market volatility during the quarter. Expenses decreased 0.2% to $342 million from the prior quarter on lower commissions and marketing costs, reflecting the benefits of our productivity initiatives. Net loss was $55 million, compared with a net loss of $33 million in the prior quarter. Adjusted net loss was $34 million, compared with adjusted net loss of $21 million in the prior quarter.
